Twenty years of building, not talking.

Who we are

TCG Real Estate, a leading player in the real estate industry since its inception in 1996, has established a strong presence across multiple cities in India. Under the aegis of global conglomerate The Chatterjee Group (TCG), we have consistently delivered world-class commercial, residential and managed living projects that epitomise India's urban growth story.

About TCG

Headquartered in New York, TCG has amassed 30+ years of experience building successful businesses across diverse sectors of the economy. Beyond real estate, the global conglomerate has also ventured into petrochemicals, life sciences, IT, textiles, financial advisory and research.

Under the leadership of our Chairman, Dr. Purnendu Chatterjee, TCG has built a reputation as one of the pioneering enterprises that embodies excellence, innovation, growth and opportunity in equal measure.

A ceaseless march towards success — a testament to our desire to create intelligent, sustainable infrastructure across the length and breadth of this country.

Our legacy

Vision

We envision a future where the places we build become integral to the communities they serve — valued for their character, relevance and the quality of life they bring.

Mission

We don't just develop spaces — we build infrastructure with lasting purpose. Every project is conceived to stand beyond changing trends and deliver enduring value to the people who experience it.
